title: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act 2017 (Luật Cắt giảm thuế)

versions.text: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (Public Law 115-97). Major provisions: Reduced corporate tax rate to 21%. Modified individual income tax brackets. Increased standard deduction. Limited state and local tax deduction (SALT) to $10,000. Created qualified business income deduction (Section 199A). Modified estate tax exemption.
